title: Build Conversational AI in minutes | Voice & Chat platform

facts.fact: ElevenLabs's conversational AI page states it is trusted by more than 7.5 million companies and creators (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Trusted by 7.5M+ companies & creators · Enterprise-grade security

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its conversational AI platform offers real-time language detection and switching across more than 90 languages (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Real-time language detection and switching across 90+ languages. Agents serve global customers without transfers or delays.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs claims a user can build a first conversational AI agent in about 5 minutes (vendor's own claim, linked to a tutorial).
facts.quote: Build your first conversational AI in 5 minutes

facts.fact: ElevenLabs's marketing page for ElevenAgents shows an example dashboard in which a high-severity tool error rate spike is up 24% in authenticated sessions (illustrative UI image, not a reported result).
facts.quote: Dashboard showing a high-severity tool error rate spike, up 24% in authenticated sessions.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs describes its telecommunications conversational AI as providing 24/7 omnichannel communication across voice and chat (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: All of this with 24/7 omnichannel communication across voice and chat.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs describes its healthcare conversational AI as providing 24/7 support for patient interactions such as intake, triage, and appointment scheduling (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: automates patient interactions like intake, triage, and appointment scheduling while providing 24/7 support.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its conversational AI offers a choice of 10,000 expressive voices, or a custom cloned voice, to match products, regions, and use cases.
facts.quote: Choose from 10,000 expressive voices (or clone yours) to match every product, region, and use case.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its conversational AI supports customers in 90+ languages with native-sounding speech.
facts.quote: Support customers in 90+ languages with native-sounding speech and consistent tone across every channel.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs' page states that integrating Zapier with its conversational AI can connect to over 8,000+ apps, including Gmail, Slack, and Salesforce.
facts.quote: connect to over 8,000+ apps, including Gmail, Slack, and Salesforce.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs' page displays a counter showing 7,118,198 agents launched, labeled 'Agents launched and counting'; this is a vendor-reported figure with no date given.
facts.quote: Agents launched and counting

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with support for SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance, and offers Regional Data Residency and Zero Retention modes.
facts.quote: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with support for SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance. Regional Data Residency and Zero Retention modes are available for stricter data control.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs describes its voice responsiveness as sub-second, which is a vendor claim with no specific latency figure given.
facts.quote: Natural, real-time voice without awkward pauses - improving resolution rates and CSAT.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states that it offers a WebSocket API and Javascript, React, Python and iOS SDKs for integrating its Conversational AI into an app.
facts.quote: Yes, we have a WebSocket API and Javascript, React, Python and iOS SDKs.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states that connecting Conversational AI to phone calls requires integrating with Twilio, Genesys, Vonage, Telynx, Plivo, or a SIP-compatible PBX or telephony system.
facts.quote: You need to integrate with Twilio, Genesys, Vonage, Telynx, Plivo or connect to any SIP compatible PBX or telephony system.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states that, inside its platform, telephony integration is a one-click process most of the time.
facts.quote: Inside the ElevenLabs platform this is a one click process most of the time

facts.fact: ElevenLabs describes its conversational AI pipeline as using Scribe to transcribe speech, an LLM to understand conversation context, and its TTS model to generate the response.
facts.quote: we use Scribe to transcribe your speech, an LLM to understand the context of a conversation and our TTS model to generate the response.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs describes its healthcare answering service agents as HIPAA-compliant voice agents.
facts.quote: Deliver 24/7 patient care continuity with HIPAA-compliant, intelligent voice agents that triage, route, and respond instantly.

facts.fact: The page lists common conversational AI use cases including customer support automation, outbound sales and lead qualification, appointment scheduling, order management, employee-facing applications, and accessibility.
facts.quote: The most common use cases include customer support automation (handling inquiries, troubleshooting, and ticket resolution 24/7), outbound sales and lead qualification

facts.fact: The vendor states its Voice AI Agent Platform lets users build production-ready conversational agents through a no-code web interface, SDKs, or APIs.
facts.quote: Build production-ready conversational agents using our no-code web interface, SDKs, or APIs, making it simple to prototype, test, and deploy voice AI agents in days - not months.

facts.fact: The vendor describes its medical call answering service as an always-on, HIPAA-compliant service powered by natural language AI.
facts.quote: Always-on, HIPAA-compliant medical call answering service powered by natural language AI

facts.fact: The vendor offers an AI recruiting and HR chatbot that screens candidates, schedules interviews, answers employee questions, and syncs with an ATS.
facts.quote: AI recruiting and HR chatbots that screen candidates, schedule interviews, answer employee questions, and sync with your ATS
